'''Finaq Shipping Company''' was an organization bringing illegal shipments of weapons into [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were investigated by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Nurls Yorksin]].
